description: A page's pictures, your own (Sightkick writes its own pages' art). An upload never edits the body: put its url in an with update_page edit. A featured image needs no tag. action: - upload(articleId, url?, data?, alt, featured?, position?): By public url (up to 8 MB) or base64 data (up to 700 KB): PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or AVIF. Returns mediaId and url. - alt(mediaId, alt): Set an image's alt text. - featured(mediaId): Make an image the featured one. - position(mediaId, position): Its place in what the site receives. - remove(mediaId): Delete an image the body no longer shows. Can't be undone.
name: update_page_images
title: Change a page's images
